_about: Asking a law enforcement agency for the T visa's optional Supplement B (src/t_visa_declaration.py; 8 CFR 214.204(e); the Supplement B instructions, edition 01/20/25): the firm's request letter and the Supplement B draft with Part 1 (the victim) and the agency's own details typed in. It goes to the agency, never to USCIS, and has no fee (Form G-1055 10/01/26). The client's documents are not sent with it. DRAFT: the attorney approves the letter before volume use.
title: T visa: law enforcement declaration request (I-914 Supplement B)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

lea_letter.title: The firm's letter asking the agency for Supplement B
attorney_completes: The letter: the attorney signs it.

handwork.text: Send the letter and the draft to the agency the way it accepts requests (mail, email or a portal), with the client's consent, and record the date in the questions above.
The official completes Parts 3-5; the official and a supervising official sign Part 6 in ink (8 CFR 214.204(e)(4); the Supplement B instructions).
When it comes back signed: add it to the client's folder, mark it returned, and put the original in the T visa packet's law enforcement exhibit. The T visa application doesn't wait for it.
